headings.instruction: CRITICAL: Never use 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Open Sans', or 'Lato' for headings. Use IBM Plex Sans for authority and technical precision. Apply tight tracking (tracking-tight).

body.instruction: Use Inter for body data legibility only.

data_numbers.instruction: Use monospace for quantities, order numbers, and timestamps to ensure vertical alignment in tables.

colors.instruction: Strict adherence to Swiss High-Contrast. No gradients. No teal green. Colors exist strictly to guide action and denote status. Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for header/overlays.

layouts.app_container: w-full max-w-[100vw] overflow-x-hidden bg-zinc-100 min-h-screen text-zinc-900
layouts.table_container: bg-white border border-zinc-200 shadow-sm rounded-none overflow-x-auto
layouts.table_cells: px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] md:text-xs whitespace-nowrap border-b border-zinc-200 align-middle
layouts.sticky_header: sticky top-0 bg-zinc-100 z-10 font-bold border-b-2 border-zinc-300
layouts.instruction: Extreme data density is required. Fit 20-30 rows on desktop. Reduce standard padding dramatically (use py-1 or py-1.5, px-2). Eliminate empty whitespace. Go full width.

tables.instruction: Dense operational grids. Must include sticky headers (sticky top-0). Use row borders (border-b) and subtle hover effects (hover:bg-zinc-50). Horizontal scrolling allowed only on mobile.

status_badges.instruction: Small pill indicators for workflow stages.
status_badges.styles: px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border

buttons.instruction: Sharp, flat, distinct. No heavy roundness. max rounded-sm. Use primary color strictly for primary CTAs.
buttons.styles: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold border border-transparent shadow-sm rounded-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 transition-colors

workflow_breadcrumb.instruction: At the top of every order/workspace, visually show: Quotation -> Brand Release -> Released -> Move to Godown or Dispatch Direct -> Dispatch -> Material Register -> Chalan -> Delivered.
workflow_breadcrumb.styles: flex flex-wrap items-center text-[10px] space-x-1.5 p-2 bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-400 rounded-sm mb-4

brand_workspace_table.instruction: ERP release table with Product, Ordered, Released, Remaining, Release Qty. Must support multi-product selection via checkboxes and a sticky 'Release Selected' batch submit button.

customer_workspace_table.instruction: Operational table with current stock buckets (Ordered, Released, Godown, Dispatched, Delivered, Remaining) and rule-based action buttons (Move to Godown, Dispatch from Released, Dispatch from Godown, Generate Chalan, View Timeline).

dispatch_list_table.instruction: Logistics table focusing on Dispatch No, Customer, Brand, Products, Boxes, Source, Destination, Vehicle, Driver, Status, Created, Actions.

material_movement_register.instruction: ERP audit log with Timestamp, Customer, Brand, Product, Movement, Quantity, From, To, Reference, User. Include dense filter bar above the table.

motion.instruction: Minimal micro-interactions. ERPs need speed and immediate responsiveness.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text passes minimum 4.5:1 contrast. Darken neutral grays if necessary.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='release-selected-btn').
accessibility.instruction: Use correct semantic table tags (th, td, tr, thead, tbody).

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp borders (border-zinc-200) on all containers. Expose the grid skeleton.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadows (shadow-sm). Do not use deep, soft, modern SaaS shadows.
visual_enhancers.instruction: Follow 'GRID BORDERS (The Technical Look)'. Surfaces must feel solid, functional, and devoid of unnecessary ornamentation.

image_urls.instruction: No imagery required for this data-dense ERP.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use .js files for React components (NOT .tsx).

Implement a mobile_web_erp_operations_workspace structure. Use React Router (or equivalent) for navigation between Tile Orders Dashboard, Brand Workspace, Customer Workspace, Dispatch List, and Material Movement Register.
Avoid the generic 'AI slop' look. Do not center-align forms or tables. Data should be left-aligned.
The UI MUST fit 20-30 rows without scrolling on a standard 1080p desktop. Reduce standard shadcn padding. Use py-1, px-2, text-[11px] or text-xs.
Use Phosphor Icons or lucide-react for iconography. Keep icons small (size 14 or 16).
Do not redesign the backend business workflow or invent new APIs. Create mock UI interactions that respect the existing states.
Implement the 'Workflow Breadcrumb' at the top of the relevant workspaces to highlight the current stage.
For 'Brand Workspace', the 'Release Selected' button must be sticky (e.g., sticky bottom-4 in the viewport) for quick batch actions.
For 'Customer Workspace', rule-based action states mean buttons should only appear or be enabled when the state permits (e.g., 'Dispatch from Godown' only available if Godown qty > 0).
Never use Space Grotesk or Inter for headings.
Ensure 'Sticky table headers' are properly implemented so warehouse staff don't lose context while scrolling large tables.
Every table cell must be dense and readable. Use 'tabular-nums' for numbers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toast notifications located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js (or .tsx converted to .js).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters ONLY where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers), never with fully transparent backgrounds.
DO NOT apply universal transition like 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions.
DO NOT center align the app container. Left-align text naturally.
NEVER use emoji characters (🤖🧠) as icons.
